intro.data: A record bundles a name and an age. Pull the NAME back out. Two extractors return an A — one gives the right name, the other gives the wrong one. Pick the genuine projection.
intro.alchemy: A compound bundles salt and sulfur. Pull the SALT back out. Two extractors return an A — one right, one wrong. Pick the genuine projection.
intro.spellcraft: A blend bundles light and heat. Pull the LIGHT back out. Two extractors return an A — one right, one wrong. Pick the genuine projection.
intro.abstract: A×B bundles A and B. Recover A with the projection that returns the right component value.

goal.data: Project the record to recover the name (Ada).
goal.alchemy: Project the compound to recover the salt.
goal.spellcraft: Project the blend to recover the light.

description.data: a record bundling a name and an age
description.alchemy: a compound blending salt and sulfur
description.spellcraft: a blend of light and heat

description.data: the name held inside the record
description.alchemy: the salt held inside the compound
description.spellcraft: the light held inside the blend

description.data: the age held inside the record
description.alchemy: the sulfur held inside the compound
description.spellcraft: the heat held inside the blend

description.data: reads the Name back out of the record
description.alchemy: draws the Salt back out of the compound
description.spellcraft: draws the Light back out of the blend
description.abstract: the first projection π₁ : A×B → A

description.data: projects out the Age, discarding the rest
description.alchemy: draws off the Sulfur, discarding the rest
description.spellcraft: draws the Heat, discarding the rest

afterSuccess.data: Get Name recovered exactly the name that went into the record. The look-alike was the same type but returned the wrong name. A product's projections faithfully read each component back out.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Salt Out recovered exactly the salt in the compound. The look-alike returned the wrong one. Projections faithfully read each component.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Draw Light recovered exactly the light in the blend. The look-alike returned the wrong one. Projections faithfully read each component.
afterSuccess.abstract: The true projection returned the bundled component; the look-alike did not.

reveal.summary: A product A×B has projections π₁ : A×B → A and π₂ : A×B → B that read each component back. They must return the actual bundled value.
reveal.moreFormal: What makes A×B a product is the universal property (next puzzle): any pair of maps into A and B factors uniquely through it.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: record.name and record.age — accessors that return the stored value.
